title: Higher low depends on the level
description: At level 1 the lows are 60,168, 61,030 and 64,589, each higher than the last, so 61,030 (19 Apr 01:00) is a higher low. The 62,263 low that the market structure break closed below is only a pivot at level 2, and there 61,030 is a lower low. Labels compare pivots within one level, so the same low can be a higher low at one level and a lower low at the next.
